### ScriptSettings

**Package:** `org.dreambot.api.settings`  
**Type:** class  
**Hierarchy:** java.lang.Object → org.dreambot.api.settings.ScriptSettings → org.dreambot.api.settings.ScriptSettings  

**Methods:**
```java
static <T> boolean exists(Class<T> clazz, String... fileLocationSteps);
static <T> T load(Class<T> clazz, String... fileLocationSteps);
static boolean save(Object obj, String... fileLocationSteps);
```

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `exists(Class<T> clazz, String... fileLocationSteps)` | Checks if a saved file exists at the provided file location steps and (if provided) checks if it can be loaded as the provided class |
| `load(Class<T> clazz, String... fileLocationSteps)` | Loads a given class from a settings object, location base is scripts.path |
| `save(Object obj, String... fileLocationSteps)` | Saves a given object using GSON pretty print to the given file. |
